judge.role: independent judge over the strengthening results; Spark saw only the numbers copied from the cited files, not the files themselves

metric: gap_closed = (factored - base) / (full - base) on mean target logprob of the answer tokens; first-token accuracy reported alongside

verdicts.claim: On the combined 96 fresh items (pair 1, Qwen2.5-0.5B), mlp_behemoth_lite closes 23.2% of the gap vs uniform_rank32 2.1%, at fewer bytes (19,358,176 vs 19,434,496).
verdicts.values_relied_on: combined-96 gap_closed 0.231923 (23.2%) for mlp_behemoth_lite at 19,358,176 B vs 0.020764 (2.1%) for uniform_rank32 at 19,434,496 B; factored means -10.545083 vs -11.095641 with base -11.149778
verdicts.note: Lite uses fewer bytes and closes ~11x the gap of uniform on the same 96 items.

verdicts.claim: Lite beats uniform on both subsets independently (heldout24: 9.5% vs 1.6%; heldout72_new: 30.4% vs 2.3%), so the earlier shrinkage pattern reversed on fresh items.
verdicts.note: Lite beats uniform on both subsets independently, and combined exceeds the first-24 figure, contrary to further shrinkage.

verdicts.claim: On the second pair (SmolLM2-360M), the byte-fair variant o-down-rebalanced (19,683,328 B, inside the 19,705,856 B uniform budget) beats uniform on the same 96 items by 0.293 nats raw mean logprob.
verdicts.values_relied_on: o-down-rebalanced 19,683,328 B inside 19,705,856 B uniform budget; 96-item factored means -8.072965 vs -8.366280 for uniform, difference 0.293 nats; base -12.878565
verdicts.note: Budget and winner identity from stage2, scores confirm 0.293-nat raw logprob margin for the byte-fair variant.

verdicts.claim: On pair 2, gap_closed exceeds 1.0 for all factored configs because they outscore the full fp16 delta itself, so gap_closed is not a recovery fraction on that pair.
verdicts.values_relied_on: uniform 1.014816, supercharge 1.088209, rebalanced 1.080783 all >1.0 because factored means -8.36628, -8.039946, -8.072965 all > full delta -8.432159; math bucket gap null where full below base
verdicts.note: With factored above full, gap_closed cannot be read as recovery fraction; raw logprob margin is the valid comparison.

verdicts.claim: The headline ruling still stands: mlp_behemoth_lite is the byte-fair leader on pair 1, and mlp_behemoth is named only as the byte-unfair parent.
verdicts.values_relied_on: excerpt lists only uniform, lite, and reference mlp_behemoth (21,719,776 B, gap 0.265984); no full byte-fair ranking or quoted prose provided
verdicts.note: Numbers show lite beats uniform and parent is byte-unfair, but leadership among all byte-fair configs and prose naming cannot be verified from numbers alone.

headline_statement: On Qwen2.5-0.5B the byte-fair mlp_behemoth_lite closes 23.2% of the mean target-logprob gap on 96 fresh items versus 2.1% for uniform rank32 at fewer bytes, winning both subsets (9.5% vs 1.6% on heldout24 and 30.4% vs 2.3% on heldout72_new) so the combined figure exceeds the earlier 9.5% first-24 figure, with byte-unfair parent mlp_behemoth at 26.6% for reference only, while on SmolLM2-360M the byte-fair o-down-rebalanced beats uniform by 0.293 nats raw mean logprob within budget, but all factored configs outscore the full fp16 delta itself so gap_closed exceeds 1.0 and is not a recovery fraction with math-bucket gaps recorded as null where full scored below base, and all results remain mean target logprob of correct tokens not task accuracy.
